label: Góc dù hồng của Hagrid
subject: Mandatory focal object: ONE tall CLOSED faded pink umbrella with curved brown handle, leaning at the LEFT side. It must extend visibly above the boots and lantern. Beside it are ONE huge rustic brass lantern and TWO oversized brown gamekeeper boots on ONE low four-legged rough timber bench. Every listed object is complete and visible. The CLOSED pink umbrella must be unmistakable and not omitted.

label: Nón Phân Loại trên ghế
subject: The battered Hogwarts Sorting Hat seated on a simple four-legged wooden stool, exactly as presented to first years: tall patched brown pointed hat with deep face-like folds forming eyes and a mouth, crooked tip, frayed wide brim. No house logos, no banners, no people, no text. The hat must look ancient and expressive, not a generic new witch hat.

label: Chiếc Cốc Lửa
subject: The Goblet of Fire as described in the book: a large rough-hewn WOODEN goblet standing on a low carved stone pedestal, jagged tall blue-violet magical flame rising from the open bowl, one small blank singed parchment slip floating just above the flame. It is wooden, NOT a gold trophy. No inscriptions or text, no surrounding Age Line or people.

label: Mề đay Slytherin
subject: Salazar Slytherin's heavy oval GOLD locket displayed on a small dark-green velvet stand with its fine gold chain draped around the base. Green gemstones form a serpent-like S ornament on the front, stylized as a winding green snake rather than readable typography. Antique gold, one mysterious violet glint, no other jewelry. The small velvet holder and its little foot are DARK forest green and black, no large bright yellow-green platform.

label: Vương miện Ravenclaw
subject: Rowena Ravenclaw's delicate silver diadem displayed on a low midnight-purple velvet cushion on a small carved stand. A silver EAGLE-shaped central motif and one deep blue gemstone, slender curved wings, no lettering or inscription. Ancient slightly tarnished magical heirloom, NOT a gold royal crown. The cushion is held by FOUR short carved legs. NO single high post or separate floor base.

label: Vòm màn che ở Bộ Pháp Thuật
subject: The ancient stone archway and fluttering black veil in the Department of Mysteries: a weathered rough grey stone arch, no door, thin ragged dark-purple translucent curtain hanging inside it with a slight billow, on two low concentric stone steps. No ghosts, no skulls, no people. Solemn magical mystery, freestanding miniature.

No title lettering, no extra books, cute but untamed.

Cake has NO writing or numbers, no rotting food, no corpse, no ghost figure.

label: Bản đồ của Đạo tặc
subject: The Marauder's Map spread open and partly folded on a small dark wooden map display table: aged parchment with tiny dark line floorplans of Hogwarts, staircase-like paths and a few tiny ink FOOTPRINT pairs; no words, no names, no readable labels. Copper corner clips and a quill. Map remains clearly the centerpiece.

label: Tượng mèo đen bằng gỗ
subject: A carved dark-purple wooden Halloween cat statue seated with an elegantly curled tail, pointed ears, one tiny orange neck bow, amber eyes. Clearly a rustic wood carving with a stable little wooden foot, not a living cat, cute and cosy. NO post, no slab, no pedestal or ground tile. Retain only the integral little wooden foot where specified.

label: Biển gỗ Halloween
subject: A crooked rustic wooden garden signpost with a pumpkin-shaped sign and a bat-shaped arrow, decorated with autumn leaves and a small cobweb. The sign contains ONLY carved pumpkin and bat pictograms, absolutely NO writing, lettering or numbers.

label: Đèn đầu lâu
subject: A cute carved ivory skull lantern on a dark copper three-legged stand, big rounded eye sockets lit with warm violet candlelight, small ornamental teeth, not realistic or gruesome. Handcrafted cosy Halloween prop. Exactly THREE copper legs touch bare ground, NO stone slab beneath them.

label: Bàn pha độc dược Halloween
subject: A rustic compact outdoor witch's potion worktable: thick plank tabletop, four sturdy legs, exactly three squat glass bottles of orange violet and teal liquid, a mortar and pestle, a small open grimoire with blank pictograms and a tiny pumpkin. Everything fits on table, no text.

label: Góc bếp
subject: A house-elf KITCHEN CORNER like the Hogwarts kitchens, set outdoors: a small low brick hearth with a glowing fire under a big copper pot steaming with stew, beside it a low wooden work table with a stack of plates, a golden pie and a brown teapot, a ladle and copper pans hanging from a short wooden rail above. Everything elf-sized, warm and busy. The hearth and table stand side by side along a 2x1 tile footprint (long axis along the strip). Bases are the ground contact.

label: Quầy bia bơ quán Ba Cây Chổi
subject: A snowy outdoor BUTTERBEER COUNTER from a cosy old village inn: a short low wooden bar counter with a snow-dusted top, three big foaming tankards of hot golden butterbeer with creamy froth on it, a small copper barrel keg with a tap at one end, a holly garland along the front and a little warm lantern on a post. Warm, inviting, steaming. The counter runs along the length of a 2x1 tile strip (in the turned view along the other axis). Its base is the ground contact.

label: Tủ kẹo tiệm Công tước Mật
subject: A wizard SWEETSHOP CABINET set outdoors in winter: a wide old wooden shop shelf-cabinet with a small striped awning on top dusted with snow, its shelves crowded with big glass jars of bright sweets, rows of chocolate frog boxes, a bundle of sugar quills, round bonbons and colourful candy sticks; a little hanging sign with a candy shape (no letters). Cheerful, crowded with colour, a child's dream. The cabinet stands along the length of a 2x1 tile strip (in the turned view along the other axis). Its base is the ground contact.

label: Cây thông Giáng sinh nhà Weasley
subject: A big homely family CHRISTMAS TREE in a wizard garden: a full fir tree in a wooden tub, decorated with golden fairy lights, red and gold baubles and paper chains, a few wrapped presents around the tub. On the very top, instead of an angel, sits a grumpy little bald potato-headed GARDEN GNOME with knobbly feet, dressed in a tutu with small wings glued to its back, scowling. Cosy, a bit chaotic, funny. The tub and presents are the ground contact on a 2x2 tile. NO post, no slab, no pedestal or ground tile. Retain only the integral little wooden foot where specified.

subject: A miniature open hexagonal wooden gazebo with a silver-gray layered shingle roof, four slim ivory pillars, small bench and flowing pale fabric tied at two posts, cozy full structure. Preserve the SIX-SIDED hexagonal floor and roof, not a square pavilion. Keep all six corners distinct and four slim visible pillars.
label: Silver-mane resting gazebo model

subject: The SAME existing keepsake statuette: a proud cream eagle-headed hippogriff with gray feathered chest and reddish-brown horse hindquarters. On its small TWO-STEP dark blue-gray square stone plinth with one blank gold plaque inset on its front face. Preserve its pose, colors and species identity. The plinth alone has horizontal world edges. No writing. Both feathered wings remain FOLDED at its sides, exactly like the original seated statuette, NOT spread or raised.

The SAME existing keepsake statuette: a black skeletal winged horse with thin bat wings folded at its sides. On its small TWO-STEP dark blue-gray square stone plinth with one blank gold plaque inset on its front face. Preserve its pose, colors and species identity. The plinth alone has horizontal world edges. No writing. The plinth is SQUARE with straight edges along the axes, never oval, round or circular.

One squat black iron brazier on three short feet with THREE large glowing orange coal rocks inside; NO flame plume. Preserve this exact original habitat, no unrelated parts. The THREE short BLACK IRON feet are stubby, less than one-tenth of the body height. NO long legs, no wood.

One squat sisal rope scratching post on a low rectangular oak base, a small brown cap at its top and ONE little yarn ball resting on its base. No animal. Preserve this exact original habitat, no unrelated parts. Its single base is OAK WOOD only, no gray stone or extra second platform.
